name: Vanilla Finest Helper
description: The players' side of the Vanilla Finest modpacks. Folders: where Flashback saves replays (without Flashback Settings) and where Axiom keeps blueprints. Home folders (off by default): on an instance's first start, points Screenshot Gallery, Litematica, Flashback and Axiom at the shared Minecraft folder. Fixes for the packs' mods are in Vanilla Finest Fixes.
